edits.old: Then the answer carries notice ids, case ids, document ids, document types, barcodes, dates and status codes only
edits.new:
Then the answer carries notice ids, case ids, document ids, document types, barcodes, dates and status codes only

  Scenario: AC17 Caller without valid credentials (error answer 401)
    Given the POST or the read is sent with no valid credentials
    When the request is sent
    Then the system returns 401
    Then nothing is written

  Scenario: AC18 rwb-document call fails with an error (BR11)
    Given the rwb-document contract call fails with an error
    When the answer is requested
    Then no partial answer is returned as complete
    Then the request stays OPENED

  Scenario: AC19 Status change not allowed by the request state model
    Given a status change of the request is asked that the request state model does not allow
    When the change is requested
    Then the change is refused
    Then nothing is written
